A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MergePrint research work with complete, readable main text and Appendices A–H. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support comparison of the equations, figures and tables.

before.justification: v2 reports original experiments on fingerprint survival after merging, downstream performance, confidentiality and robustness in Section 6, with further empirical results in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the main fingerprinting evaluations and the Mistral-based experiments in Appendix H.

M1.justification: Section 5 and Algorithm 1 retain the same pseudo-merged model, regularized input optimization (OptI) and parameter optimization (OptP). The objectives and algorithm steps are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same downstream benchmarks, Alpaca fine-tuning data and Japanese MGSM/JAQKET evaluation in Appendix H. Coverage of merging, pruning, quantization and inference-time scenarios is unchanged.

E2.justification: TRAP and IF, implemented as IF-SFT, retain identical participation in corresponding main-text and appendix comparisons. No comparator is added, removed or revised.

E3.justification: The model configurations, merging coefficients, optimization settings, exact-prefix VSR metric and decoding parameters are identical. The appendices also retain the same experimental procedures.

E4.justification: The OptI ablations, hyperparameter sensitivity, fingerprint-output selection, multiple-fingerprint experiments, pruning analyses and inference-time robustness tests are unchanged, including their appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the 30-trial averaging in Table 3, three-trial summaries with plus/minus reporting in Table 7, and five-trial averaging for random pruning in Appendix C. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout. For example, Table 4 retains Alpaca fine-tuning VSRs of 1.0 for MergePrint, 0.34 for IF and 0.0 for TRAP.

T1.justification: The model-merging definitions, threat assumptions, fingerprinting objectives and mathematical formulations are identical. No formal reasoning or proof is added, removed or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about merge-resistant black-box ownership verification, efficient embedding, minimal performance disruption and resistance to broader model modifications.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and qualifications are unchanged, including the knowledge-distillation limitation in Section 8 and Appendix H's interpretation of fingerprint loss when merging fails to preserve model capabilities.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility disclosures are identical, including Appendix A's hyperparameters, Appendix G's single NVIDIA A100 hardware and Section 10's supplemental-code and future public-release statements. Embedded external link targets also match.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works and the bibliography are unchanged. The positioning relative to existing fingerprinting methods and merging-resistant backdoor research remains identical.

P1.justification: The third and fourth authors exchange positions: Koki Wataoka precedes Tsubasa Takahashi in v2, and the order is reversed in v4. The arXiv version/date stamp changes; body prose and section structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Small vertical-spacing adjustments move Table 4 and nearby left-column text on page 8. Figure designs, table structures, captions and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations and reproducibility information are unchanged across the main text and appendices. The author-order update and small page 8 spacing adjustments establish no meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
